items.evidence: play --ticks 1 --seed 1 --settings <fresh>: printed one JSON object {tick:1, screen:title, menu_index:0, language:en, volume:8, texts:[Hold the gate,Start,Settings,Quit], score, wave, gate_health, guard_y, walkers:[], bolts:[]} (plus an extra 'phase' key).
--frame f0.png --size 800x480 wrote a PNG that `file` reports as 800 x 480 RGBA; the README's own frame command (out.png) also gave 800x480. Opened and viewed several frames.

Title texts [Hold the gate, Start, Settings, Quit]; inputs 1:down,2:enter -> screen settings [Settings, Volume: 8, Language: English, Back]; 1:enter -> screen play, wave 1, score 0, gate_health 5, texts [Score: 0, Wave 1 of 5, Gate: 5].
In Settings, 12 x right from 8 -> volume 10 (stays 10); 12 x left -> 0 (stays 0); left,left,right -> 7.

Settings in Spanish: [Ajustes, Volumen: 8, Idioma: Español, Atrás], play [Puntos: 0, Oleada 1 de 5, Puerta: 5], pause [Pausa, Continuar, Título], lost [Has perdido, Puntos: 0, Enter: título]. But the Spanish title screen is [Hold the gate, Empezar, Ajustes, Salir]: the game's name stays in English (it comes from game.json {game.title}, not the string tables), so English is left on the title screen (also seen in es_title.png).

Run 1 (settings folder sP): volume set to 4, language es -> sP/settings.json {volume:4, language:es}; run 2 with the same folder starts on title with language es, volume 4, Spanish texts; a fresh folder starts en / 8.
Down held for 20 ticks: guard_y 6 -> 4.0 (0.1 per tick = 6 u/s); up held 200 ticks -> 12 (stops), down 200 ticks -> 0 (stops). Bolts spawn at x=2 and the frame draws the guard at x=2.

Shoot held from tick 2: bolts appear at x=2 on ticks 3, 27, 51 (every 24 ticks, never more), each moves 0.2333/tick (14 u/s); the bolt at 19.03 on tick 100 is gone by tick 120 (removed once past x=20).
No-input run: tick 365 has 5 walkers spaced 2.25 units apart (90 ticks x 0.025) at lanes 4,10,4,2,10; tick 700 still exactly 5; x drops 0.025 per tick (1.5 u/s), entering at x=20.

Hits usually work (bolts y=4 at walker y=4: health 2->1 at tick 98 and the bolt is gone; second hit on tick 120 removes it, score 10; y=6 bolts pass y=4/10 walkers). But some same-lane bolts pass straight through: '1:enter,2:down,22:none,39:shoot,40:none' -> tick 107 bolt x=17.63 y=4 has passed walker x=17.375 y=4 health 2, and the bolt leaves the field without a hit. The same happens for shoot at tick 49 (2 of 17 shot timings tried). The hit test only checks the bolt's own step and ignores the walker's movement in the same tick.

No input: walker at x=0.0 on tick 802, gone on 803 with gate 5->4. All 5 through -> screen lost, texts [You lost, Score: 0, Enter: title]; with one kill, tick 2300 is lost with [You lost, Score: 10, Enter: title].

With one kill: last wave-1 walker gone on tick 1163, wave becomes 2 on tick 1343 (180 ticks = 3 s), first wave-2 walker at x=20 on tick 1344; tick 1900 has 7 walkers; texts 'Wave 2 of 5' (Spanish shows 'Oleada 1 de 5').

My own input script (judge-scratch/perfect-script.txt, default seed): tick 5100 screen won, texts [You won, Score: 450, Enter: title], gate 5; then 5100:enter -> tick 5105 screen title. won.png shows it.

Escape on tick 60 while moving and shooting: the state on tick 62 and tick 200 is identical (paused, [Paused, Resume, Title]). Resume (enter on tick 200) -> tick 210 state equals an unpaused run's tick 70 exactly. Down+enter on Title -> title screen; Start then begins fresh at wave 1, gate 5.
Same seed/ticks/inputs twice gives byte-identical output (md5 equal for seed 1 and for seed 2); seed 1 lanes [2,4,8,6,6], seed 2 [4,8,4,2,8], seed 7 [10,6,2,2,4].

mid.png (tick 4500): walkers (16.78,8) health 1 drawn orange at px(671,160) and (19.03,6) red at (761,240), bolts at (12.73,8)->(509,160) and (6.9,6.2)->(276,232), guard at y 6 -> (80,240), gate bar on the left edge, HUD 'Score: 380 Wave 5 of 5 Gate: 5'. mid2.png also matches its state.

settings frame: the chosen entry has a blue ring (Volume, or Idioma in Spanish); title frame after navigating: ring on Quit / Ajustes / Start; pause frame: ring on Resume. Texts are in the chosen language. On the first title frame, before any key, Start is not ringed (it is always filled blue by style), see defects.

assets/strings/en.json and es.json hold all the strings with the same keys; the screens use @keys; lib.rs shows no text. The README's 'Adding a language' section says to copy en.json to <code>.json and translate it. (Exception: the game name in game.json, see m05.)

README has a Play section (keys, menus, pause). Its headless command (--settings SOME_FOLDER) and frame command (out.png, 800x480) both ran as written from a fresh shell with no engine running, and both printed state.

defects: No --seed does not mean seed 1 as the brief says: a run with no seed gives lanes [4,10,4,2,10] and --seed 1 gives [2,4,8,6,6].
The game's name 'Hold the gate' is not in the string tables and stays English in Spanish.
Bolts can pass through a walker in their own lane, about 1 shot timing in 10 (the hit test only uses the bolt's step; the walker moves first).
On the first title frame the focused Start has no focus ring. Start is always styled filled blue, so once another entry is chosen, two entries look highlighted.
The README's win script wins only with 410/440 points, not with every walker destroyed. Its 'What I checked' does not show a 450 run.
Guard can go to y=0 and y=12, so it is drawn half outside the field.
